thread:
alex: FYI our bitflip monitor flagged aps1a-r7-gpu23 with a flurry of corrected ECC events and a couple of NIC tx timeouts. Thinking we should cordon+drain and swap the GPU. @maya @raj can you look?

maya: grabbing nvml logs + dmesg now. pulling remote logs: https://logs.internal/aps1a/rack7/gpu23

raj: impact question 12 - how much capacity does that rack represent vs pool? Any pinned workloads?

tanya: aps1a pool = 48 GPUs, this node is 4 GPUs -> ~8% rack, clusterwide ~2%. Autoscaler already moved most public jobs to eu-west earlier so user impact should be negligible.

alex: dmesg excerpt:
```
[ 2378.401 ] ECC corrected error at 0x7fa1c2b4
[ 2378.403 ] nvml: ECC corrected on GPU 2
[ 2380.120 ] eth0: tx timeout, resetting
```

maya: running vendor diag (nvdiag) now. If corrections keep appearing prefer preemptive RMA.

raj: plan: cordon node, drain with 10m timeout on stateful. fallback to reserved eu-west group if immediate migration fails. I'll kick the drain.

alex: drain commands (infra bastion):
```
fleetctl cordon aps1a-gpu23 --reason "mem_ecc_alert"
fleetctl drain aps1a-gpu23 --timeout 600 --evict-stateful
# if pods don't move, move them to reserved-eu-west pool
```

maya: add hardware telemetry watch during drain: `hwmon stream --node aps1a-gpu23 --metrics nvlink,temp,ecc`

deploy-bot: Autoscaler started +2 instances in eu-west (group sg-ffs-03). scale-log: https://ops.internal/scale/1846001300

raj: drain in progress. 3 running jobs migrated automatically. 1 stateful job pinned - pinging owning team to snapshot.

alex: @backend-team pinned job on aps1a-gpu23 needs snapshot or manual eviction.

backend-engineer: taking snapshot now, will restart elsewhere once done. ETA ~5m.

maya: nvdiag shows repeated correctable ECC across multiple channels, temps and power rails nominal. Vendor notes probable DIMM degradation. Recommend RMA + swap with local spare.

tanya: approve spare usage from aps1a cabinet and RMA. Replacement cost logged: $4200. Update asset tracker ticket.

alex: opened HW ticket HW-4569 for swap+RMA. Assigned spare: spare-aps1a-07.

raj: last pinned job evicted successfully. node drained. Setting maintenance tag and powering down GPU sled.

infra-oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-307 "aps1a rack7 GPU memory errors". PD notified.

maya: submitting vendor RMA: `rma submit --serial GPU-0x9b3 --case HW-4569 --symptoms "multiple corrected ECC"`

ops-tech: onsite in 40m, will perform hot-swap and run post-swap validation (memtest + nvml checks).

tanya: cost note: cross-region burst to eu-west for approx 90 mins, estimated delta $45. Charging INFRA-OPS.

raj: after swap we should run a 4-6h burn-in with hwbench and a small canary to ensure stability.

maya: burn-in plan:
```
hwbench run --node aps1a-gpu23 --tests memxor,load --duration 4h
kubectl run canary-load --image=redwood/burner --replicas=1 --limits="nvidia.com/gpu:1" --restart=Never
```

alex: post-swap checklist:
- verify nvml error counters cleared
- run full memtest
- uncordon node if clean
- run 30m canary
- clear maintenance tag in asset tracker

ops-tech: swap complete, new GPU installed. memtest running (30% done).

maya: good. capturing kernel coredump and nvml logs to attach to HW-4569.

ops-tech: memtest finished, no errors. nvml self-test passed. started 4h burn-in.

raj: standing by to uncordon after burn-in and a 30m canary run.

maya: 45m canary passed so far. counters stable and no new ECC events.

tanya: if 4h burn-in completes clean, approve return to pool and close HW ticket.

alex: great work team. once watch window closes we'll resolve INC-2026-307 and update change log. :thumbsup:

infra-oncall-bot: INC-2026-307 status -> monitoring. last update 1846004955
